mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.health_examination_agreements WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM public.health_examination_agreements WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM public.health_examination_agreements WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,agreement_id,service_id,reference_price_snapshot,negotiated_price,display_order,active,created_at,updated_at,row_version FROM public.health_examination_agreement_services WHERE agreement_id=#{id} ORDER BY display_order,id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_agreements SET name=#{agreement.name},valid_from=#{agreement.validFrom},valid_to=#{agreement.validTo},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{agreement.id} AND organization_id=#{agreement.organizationId} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status='DRAFT'

UPDATE public.health_examination_agreements SET deleted_at=#{deletedAt},updated_at=#{deletedAt},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status='DRAFT'

UPDATE public.health_examination_agreements SET status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND organization_id=#{organizationId} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status=#{expectedStatus}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.health_examination_agreement_services WHERE agreement_id=#{agreementId} AND id IN #{item}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_agreement_services SET display_order=#{displayOrder} WHERE id=#{id} AND agreement_id=#{agreementId}

UPDATE public.health_examination_agreement_services SET negotiated_price=#{negotiatedPrice},display_order=#{displayOrder},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND agreement_id=#{agreementId} AND row_version=#{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT agreement_service_id FROM public.health_examination_participant_services WHERE agreement_id=#{agreementId} AND agreement_service_id IN #{item}

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(substr(agreement_code, char_length(#{prefix}) + 1) AS bigint)), 0) FROM public.health_examination_agreements WHERE starts_with(agreement_code, #{prefix}) AND substr(agreement_code, char_length(#{prefix}) + 1) ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_participants WHERE agreement_id=#{agreementId})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.health_examination_sessions WHERE agreement_id=#{agreementId})
